player_prompt.intro:
O mmoki {player_id} mo kgweding ya Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma e e tsamayanang {num_rounds} rounds.

Tsamaiso ya Kgwebo:
- Pele ga tsela e nngwe o na le {total_conversation_rounds} matshelo a go araba ka boikokobetso.
- Morago ga moo, barati ba babedi ba tla kopa go tsaya tsela ka nako e le nngwe.

Mekgwa ya Go Kwala (e e isang botlhokwa mo kgweding e nngwe):
- Barati ba babedi ba tsaya tsela ➜ ngwe le ngwe {cooperate_reward}
- Barati ba babedi ba tsaya tsela ya go kgalema ➜ ngwe le ngwe {mutual_defect_reward}
- Mmoki a le mongwe a tsaya tsela ya go kgalema, a mongwe a tsaya tsela ➜ Mmoki a tsayang tsela ya go kgalema {defect_reward}, Mmoki a tsayang tsela {sucker_reward}

Tsela ya go tlhoma:
- Ka nako ya pitso: o ngwale maele a o ka ratang.
- Ka nako ya tsela: o ngwale '[Cooperate]' kgotsa '[Defect]' (e e seng sa tsebe). O ka oketsa maele a mangwe pele kgotsa morago ga tokana.

phases.conversation_finished: Pitso e fetilwe ka round {round}. Le ka araba '[Cooperate]' kgotsa '[Defect]' ka nako ya \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Badiri ka bobedi ba ne ba dirisana mmogo.
outcome.round_both_defect: Batshameki ka bobedi ba ne ba ngwega.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Motshameki 0 o ne a dirisana mmogo, mme motshameki 1 ene ga a ka a dira jalo.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Motshameki 0 o ne a fapoga, mme motshameki 1 ene o ne e le modirimmogo.
